Comments:
Happy Thanksgiving from all of us at Nub's Nob! Unfortunately, there isn't enough cold air for a Thanksgiving Weekend opening. Even so, the Lodge, General Store, Tune Center, Cafeteria, Pub, and Locker Room will be open Friday and Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. We hope you'll stop by this weekend while we get ready for ski season. Catch the Michigan vs. Ohio State game in Nub's Pub on Saturday! Think cold and snow!
